title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Are you a creative, data-driven marketer looking to make a real impact? This is an exciting opportunity to join a nationally recognised engineering products and industrial services business with a strong UK presence and an extensive network of branches nationwide.

As a market-leading organisation experiencing continued growth, the company is investing heavily in its brand, digital presence, and customer engagement strategy. You'll have the chance to take ownership of innovative marketing campaigns, work closely with commercial teams across the business, and play a key role in driving lead generation, brand awareness, and business growth.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an ambitious Digital Marketing Executive who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to be part of a business where their ideas, creativity, and expertise will make a tangible difference. Please note this role is 5 days onsite.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Plan, manage, and execute end-to-end digital marketing campaigns.
- Create engaging content across various channels including social media, email marketing, websites, and digital advertising.
- Manage and expand the company's social media presence.
- Develop both organic and paid campaigns to enhance lead generation and customer engagement.
- Support SEO initiatives and assist with PPC campaign management and optimisation.
- Maintain and develop website content and landing pages.
- Design marketing materials using Adobe Creative Suite and Canva.
- Monitor campaign performance using analytics tools, providing regular reporting and insights.
- Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing activities with commercial objectives.
- Support product launches, exhibitions, company events, and new site openings.
- Create and manage photography and video content, ensuring brand consistency across all marketing communications and customer touchpoints.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Minimum of 2 years' experience in a Digital Marketing Executive role or similar.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing channels including SEO, PPC, email marketing, social media, content marketing, and website management.
- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and strong Canva skills.
- Excellent copywriting and content creation abilities.
- Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
- Commercially minded with a results-focused approach.

Desirable Experience:
- Background in B2 B, industrial, engineering, manufacturing, or technical environments.
- Experience with marketing automation or CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Mailchimp, or Salesforce.
- Skills in photography, videography, and basic video editing.
- Understanding of Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) and experience managing Google Ads and/or LinkedIn advertising campaigns.

Benefits:
- 20 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to purchase up to 5 additional days.
- Company pension scheme.
- Wellbeing support and employee rewards platform.
- Paid volunteering day.
- Employee referral and Cycle to Work schemes.
- Full training and ongoing professional development.

Apply now!

title: Growth Marketing Executive
description:
Growth Marketing Executive

Ashford, Kent - Hybrid

Up to £35,000
- Are you already working in marketing and ready to take on more ownership?
- Do you have some hands-on experience of campaigns, CRM, email marketing, content or lead generation and want to understand how all of those pieces work together?
- Looking for a role where you can bring your own ideas, experiment and see the commercial impact of the marketing you deliver?

We are recruiting for a Growth Marketing Executive to join an established international software business working with major newspaper and magazine publishers around the world.

This is a broad, hands-on role sitting closely alongside the sales team.

You won't be joining a large marketing department where you are responsible for one tiny piece of the puzzle. Instead, you will get involved across campaigns, content, lead generation, events, CRM and reporting, helping turn marketing activity into genuine sales opportunities.

You will work closely with the Chief Revenue Officer, who will set the overall growth strategy, but there will be plenty of scope for you to bring ideas, test different approaches and take ownership of delivery.

You will get involved in:
- Creating and delivering email, LinkedIn, paid and organic campaigns
- Building and segmenting target audiences
- Supporting outbound prospecting and lead generation
- Qualifying and managing marketing leads before passing opportunities to the sales team
- Creating content including blogs, case studies, whitepapers and sales collateral
- Supporting webinars, conferences and industry events
- Managing campaign and lead activity within the CRM
- Monitoring campaign performance and understanding what is generating engagement, leads and pipeline
- Supporting website and landing page activity
- Working closely with Business Development Managers to understand which campaigns and leads are converting
- Bringing forward new campaign ideas and testing different approaches

What we are looking for

You don't need to have done everything above already, but we are now looking for someone who has gained some commercial marketing experience and understands what it is like to deliver marketing activity within a real business.

You may currently be a Marketing Executive, Marketing Assistant, Digital Marketing Executive or similar and be ready for a broader role.

Ideally, you will have some experience across several of the following:
- Email marketing and campaigns
- CRM systems such as HubSpot or Salesforce
- Audience segmentation
- Social and LinkedIn marketing
- Content creation
- Campaign reporting and analytics
- Lead generation or working alongside a sales team
- Website or landing page management
- Events or webinars

B2 B, SaaS or technology experience would be useful but isn't essential.

More important is that you are commercially curious.

We want someone who doesn't simply ask "Did the campaign get engagement?" but also wants to know "Did it generate the right leads and what happened to them?"

You will need to be comfortable bringing ideas to the table, trying things, looking at the results and changing your approach when something isn't working.

This would suit somebody who has already built the foundations of their marketing career and is now looking for the opportunity to broaden their experience and become a much more commercially focused marketer.

title: Marketing Executive
description:

The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting and delivering marketing activity, working across content, social media, digital marketing, campaigns, events, and analytics.

This role will suit someone who is organised, adaptable, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication skills, a willingness to learn, and a positive, proactive attitude are essential. There is a path for great career progression and growth within the role and is perfect for someone at a junior level looking to expand their skill set even further with a great 'go get it' attitude!

Key Responsibilities
- Create engaging content for websites, blogs, email campaigns, social media, and marketing materials.
- Produce SEO-focused content, including website pages, FAQs, metadata, and digital assets.
- Ensure all content is accurate, compliant, and aligned with brand guidelines.
- Create and adapt marketing assets, including social media graphics, web banners, brochures, and digital advertisements.
- Support the creation and editing of video content for social media and digital channels.
- Develop, schedule, and manage content across social media platforms.
- Assist with the planning, filming, and delivery of social media campaigns and video content.
- Support the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across digital, email, social media, advertising, and events.
- Support website updates, content management, and optimisation initiatives.
- Assist with SEO performance monitoring, keyword tracking, and content improvement strategies.
- Coordinate marketing support for events, webinars, and industry exhibitions.
- Assist with the delivery of email marketing campaigns and customer nurture journeys.
- Monitor campaign, website, social media, and email performance.
- Produce regular marketing reports and provide insights to support future marketing activity.
- Contribute ideas and recommendations to improve marketing performance, engagement, and lead generation.
- Effectively manage multiple projects and priorities while meeting deadlines.

What we need from you:
- Excellent copywriting and written communication skills. ( with SEO desirable)
- Social media management experience
- A broad skill set from email to social content
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Proactive and self-motivated approach.
- Experience using Adobe Photoshop and video editing software

- Naturally curious with a willingness to learn and develop.
- Comfortable receiving feedback and coaching.

This is a hybrid position with 4 days in the office after probation. If you would like to find out more about this position then get in touch ASAP.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Are you an ambitious, hands-on Marketing Manager looking for the opportunity to build and shape a marketing function from the ground up?

Our client is a growing and ambitious manufacturer supplying leading UK and international retailers with high-quality homeware products, while also developing and marketing its own portfolio of consumer brands.

As part of its next phase of growth, our client is looking to appoint an experienced Marketing Manager to establish, lead and deliver the company's marketing strategy. This is a newly created standalone role offering significant autonomy, influence and the opportunity to make a lasting impact on the future success of the business.

Working closely with the senior leadership team, as well as Sales, Design and Product Development, you will play a key role in strengthening the company's brand portfolio, driving customer engagement, supporting commercial growth and increasing brand awareness across both B2 B and consumer channels.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and implement the company's overall marketing strategy.
- Manage and develop the company's portfolio of brands.
- Plan, deliver and evaluate integrated marketing campaigns.
- Identify new market opportunities and support business growth initiatives.
- Manage and develop the company's websites and digital content.
- Create engaging email marketing campaigns and customer communications.
- Produce high-quality marketing collateral, brochures, presentations, catalogues and sales support materials.
- Lead social media activity and content creation across multiple platforms.
- Work collaboratively with the Sales, Design and Product Development teams to support new product launches and customer presentations.
- Represent the business at trade shows, exhibitions and industry events.
- Maintain marketing databases and CRM systems.
- Monitor campaign performance, analyse ROI and provide recommendations to optimise future marketing activity.

About You

You will be a commercially minded marketing professional who enjoys taking ownership and turning ideas into results. You will be equally comfortable developing strategy as you are delivering campaigns and creating engaging content.

To be successful in the role, you will ideally have:
- Previous experience in a Marketing Manager or Senior Marketing Executive position.
- Experience within home fragrance, homewares, gifting, consumer products, retail, FMCG or a related sector.
- Strong digital marketing and social media expertise.
- Excellent copywriting, communication and presentation skills.
- Experience managing websites, email marketing platforms and CRM systems.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
- A proactive, creative and entrepreneurial approach, with the confidence to work independently and drive initiatives forward.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary of circa £50,000, depending on experience.
- Performance-related bonus.
- Comprehensive benefits package.
- The opportunity to build and lead the marketing function within a growing and entrepreneurial business.
- A varied and rewarding role with genuine scope to influence business strategy and support future growth.

If you are looking for an opportunity where your ideas will be valued and your contribution will directly influence the continued success of a growing business, we would like to hear from you.

Apply now for a confidential discussion and further details.

title: People Engagement Officer
description:

- Coordinate the employee engagement calendar and culture initiative
- Support organisational change programmes from a people perspective.
- Contribute employee insight and communications to transformation projects.
- Help embed company values within people processes and practices.
- Work collaboratively across HR and wider business teams.

Requirements:
- 3-5 years' experience in HR, employee engagement, internal communications, or a related field.
- Strong ability to turn feedback into practical actions.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience supporting change and transformation initiatives.
- Strong organisational and project management skills.
- Good understanding of employee experience, culture, and people processes.
- CIPD or related qualifications desirable but not essential.

In return, our client offers:
- Competitive salary.
- Hybrid and flexible working opportunities.
- Generous holiday allowance.

- Employee wellbeing initiatives.
- The opportunity to make a real impact within a growing and evolving organisation.
- Private Medical Insurance

Apply Now

If you're passionate about creating positive employee experiences and want to play a key role in driving engagement, communication, and culture, we'd love to hear from you.
